items.q: If I break a one year FD after 8 months, what rate will I actually earn?
items.answer: After 8 months your money stayed in the 180-days-to-under-1-year band, which earns 6.0% a year [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates], and breaking early deducts a 1% penalty [03_fixed_deposits#premature-withdrawal]. So you'd actually earn 5.0% a year on that FD.

items.q: I reported fraud on my savings account 5 working days after it happened. What is my maximum liability and when do I see a shadow credit?
items.answer: Your liability is capped at Rs 10,000, since 5 working days falls in the 4-to-7 working day window for savings accounts [06_disputes_and_fraud#reporting-unauthorised-transactions]. The disputed amount is credited to your account as a shadow credit within 10 working days while the bank investigates [06_disputes_and_fraud#shadow-credit].

items.q: Did my SIP get debited in August 2026, and what fee do I pay if a SIP instalment fails?
items.answer: Yes — Rs 5,000.00 was debited to Tunga SIP Desk on 2026-08-05 [ledger]. If an instalment fails, the bank charges a bounce fee of Rs 250, and after 3 consecutive missed instalments the fund house cancels the SIP [07_mutual_funds_sip#missed-sip-instalments].

items.q: What extra savings account interest do senior citizens get at Tunga Bank?
items.answer: Tunga Bank's savings account interest is 2.75% a year up to Rs 1 lakh and 3.25% above that, with no senior-citizen add-on mentioned [01_savings_account#interest-on-savings]. The extra 0.5% for those 60 and above applies to fixed deposits, on every tenure [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates].

items.q: What is the penalty for breaking a tax saver FD early?
items.answer: A tax saver FD has a 5-year lock-in with no premature withdrawal at all, so there is no early-break penalty — you simply can't break it [03_fixed_deposits#tax-saver-fd]. For other FDs, breaking early pays the rate for the period the money actually stayed, minus a 1% penalty [03_fixed_deposits#premature-withdrawal].
